objective.name: sandbox.consume.record
objective.description: Consume a structured record and return a compact summary.

#root.role: Consume a few structured params and return one summary string.

transformation_contract.morphing: A structured record view becomes one compact summary string.
invariants: message, source_ctx, and revision are coerced to trimmed strings before summary construction.
The summary format is deterministic: source_ctx:message:revision.
ctx_id and wrapper_name are derived from the active wrapper runtime environment.
success: On success, sandbox.consume.record returns summary, handled_by, ctx_id, and wrapper_name.
handled_by identifies the concrete wrapper capability that produced the summary.
failure: sandbox.consume.record has no contract-level validation failure for missing params because absent values are normalized to empty strings.
The capability only fails if the underlying wrapper runtime cannot execute.
notes: This capability is used as a deterministic terminal consumer in N7 orchestration chains.
The payload shape is intentionally compact to make final assertions easy.
